segments.contextAfter: **iOS displays an outdated launch screen.** Your new Xcode build has not overwritten the old launch screen. Clean your build folder for your project. In Xcode, select your target, then select the menu Product, menu item Clean Build Folder. Remove the app from device or Simulator. Build and run the app again.
segments.documentTitle: TN3118: Debugging your app’s launch screen

segments.source: **iOS displays an outdated launch screen.** Your new Xcode build has not overwritten the old launch screen. Clean your build folder for your project. In Xcode, select your target, then select the menu Product, menu item Clean Build Folder. Remove the app from device or Simulator. Build and run the app again.
segments.normalizedSource: **iOS displays an outdated launch screen.** Your new Xcode build has not overwritten the old launch screen. Clean your build folder for your project. segments.contextBefore: Check why your launch screen fails to display:
segments.contextAfter: **iOS displays the last shown view controller.** When your app enters the background, iOS takes a snapshot of the app, and displays the snapshot on subsequent launches. If you want your launch screen to appear again, remove your app from the device, and run it again from Xcode.
